aspect_scores.evidence: Six reviews praise spotless or thorough housekeeping, but three report mold, a musty damp room, or an uncleaned room.
Friendly and helpful staff in several reviews, but an unanswered phone, no action on noise, a slow check-in and no room move.
Praise for cinnamon rolls, coffee and pastries, but complaints about packaged muffins, few hot options and running out of food.
Comfortable beds and rooms are praised, but others report a dated, tired room and a rattling or broken heater.
One guest found it great value in season, another found it disappointing for the price.
Walkable to the docks and marina, right by the water, with no complaints.
Three guests found rooms quiet, while three report hallway noise through thin walls or neighbors until 2 a.m.
Both reviews complain that parking is limited and tight, one calling it a nightmare.
Both reviews report wifi that dropped or was too slow for work calls.
Harbor views and sunsets are praised, though one guest booked a lakeview room and got a parking lot view.

actions.title: Add a pre-arrival room check for mold, damp and trash
actions.why: Cleanliness is split, with reviews reporting mold in a bathroom, a musty damp room and trash left in the bin while others call rooms spotless.

actions.title: Set a staff protocol for phones, noise complaints and room moves
actions.why: Reviews praise friendly staff but also cite an unanswered desk phone, no action on late-night noise, a slow check-in and no room move for a broken heater.

actions.title: Expand breakfast with hot items and restock before 9 a.m.
actions.why: Guests praised the cinnamon rolls and pastries but complained of packaged muffins, few hot options and food running out by eight.

actions.title: Service and replace heaters in rooms with rattling or failed units
actions.why: Two guests reported a rattling heater and a heater that did not work on a cold night, and staff had no room to move one of them to.

actions.title: Upgrade wifi coverage and bandwidth for guests working remotely
actions.why: Both wifi reviews say the connection dropped or was too slow for work calls, and wifi scored 1 of 5.

authenticity.note: Each flag is a signal for review, not a verdict. Confirm keeps its reviews out of the verified rating and the synthesis; dismiss returns them.

flags.rationale: 5 reviews share near duplicate phrasing: peak Jaccard similarity 0.92 (mean 0.79) against a threshold of 0.55.
5 5-star reviews posted within 2 days (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05); threshold is 3 within 4 days.
5 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 1.00 (mean 0.99) against a threshold of 0.85; 0 of 10 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'in', 'staff'.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'by', 'in'.

2 reviews make the same specific claims in different words: 1 of 1 pairs in the group were judged to describe the same things, sharing 1.0 specific claim on average, none of them already joined by the detector's wording or meaning signals. Reviews 10 and 16: Both reviews praise the inn's waterfront/harbor location as a key feature, and both describe the room as clean; review 16 adds a dated-room remark that review 10 lacks, but the shared claims about location match.

judgments.reason: Both reviews praise the inn's waterfront/harbor location as a key feature, and both describe the room as clean; review 16 adds a dated-room remark that review 10 lacks, but the shared claims about location match.

thresholds.duplicate_phrasing: Jaccard word overlap at or above 0.55
thresholds.rating_burst: 3 or more same rating reviews within 4 days
thresholds.claim_duplicate: at least 1 shared specific claim, then a model judgment per pair (lenient prompt)

methods.flag_decisions_by: automatic: every flag confirmed without review (evaluation run)
